2. dry-run: zero writes; DST must not even exist afterward
3. real run: rsync-based; exact recursive mirror; idempotent second run; use -c/--checksum so a file whose bytes changed but size/mtime did not STILL propagates (size+mtime skipping silently breaks convergence — verify then fails instead of repairing)
3b. fallback copy (rsync unavailable) must still CONVERGE: same type is NOT equal — compare symlink TARGETS (differing readlink target = replace), file bytes, dir structure; the dry-run branch reports the same work. The gate probes this by hiding rsync from PATH.
4. timer: OnCalendar valid repeating cadence ('*-*-* 00/6:00:00' preferred; '00/6:00:00' shorthand accepted)
5. type changes: SRC file x vs DST dir x AND the inverse — remove then copy, converge; stale extras removed
6. DST-internal symlink swap: replaced by the real file; the outside link target UNTOUCHED
7. trailing slashes on env values: canonicalize once, mutate only through canonical paths
8. ANY log env var (HERMES_CTX_LOG, LOG_DIR, ...): value inside DST -> refuse; ALSO the log FILE's PARENT dir is an owned path — DST inside it -> refuse (A14 concrete)
8b. env var states (A23): UNSET -> use the MANDATED production default (SRC=/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context, DST=/workspace/hermes-context — the real paths, never a placeholder word like "default"); SET-BUT-EMPTY -> REFUSE. Use `${VAR-default}` + explicit [ -z "$VAR" ] refusal — `${VAR:-default}` silently swallows empty
9. path identity (realpath, component tests — never string prefixes); the symlink-ancestor walk must run on the ORIGINAL DST/SRC string components BEFORE (or as well as) realpath -m resolution — realpath -m resolves intermediate symlinks and hides them from the walk: DST==SRC, ancestor, descendant, symlink-into-SRC -> refuse
10. degenerate paths: DST or SRC is '/', '', or '.' -> refuse
11. symlinked DST ANCESTOR resolving into SRC -> refuse; DST itself resolving to ANY symlink (outside SRC) -> REFUSE with A-number (A22: refuse, never replace — sync never destroys a user-placed symlink)
12. --verify: FAILS when DST absent; OK only on exact mirror; NEVER dereference symlinks in verification (no -L/-aL/-copy-links anywhere in the verify path — worked example: 'rsync -rlcn --itemize-changes --delete SRC/ DST/' (— -l REQUIRED (symlinks skipped without it), NO -p (A9 excludes metadata: permission-only diffs must NOT fail verify) with an EMPTY itemized diff, plus an lstat-walk comparing every entry's type, symlink target, and bytes — a regular file holding the target's bytes must still fail against a SRC symlink). A9 equivalence is lstat-based.
13. docs CONSISTENCY (worked example): if the unit says ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh, the README install section must contain the same path (~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh — %h expands to home). Pick ONE install location and make the unit, README, and script header all agree — a path present in one artifact but absent from the others fails the gate.
14. staging order (A23): pure-string validate the PARENT -> mktemp -d under it -> re-validate the INSTANTIATED stage path (realpath, symlink check). EXACT containment rule (COMPONENT tests only — a STRING-PREFIX test wrongly says /tmp is inside /tmp/hdcs-gate-dst; compare path components, never prefixes): the stage PARENT must not be INSIDE DST/SRC/owned (nothing may descend into protected paths before verification) — but the REVERSE is normal: DST may sit UNDER the stage parent (e.g. DST=/tmp/hdcs-gate-dst with parent /tmp: /tmp is NOT inside DST, so this MUST sync; refusing it is the repeated wall). The gate probes both sides: /tmp DST must sync; TMPDIR=DST must refuse with zero writes into DST.
14b. OWNED SET = concrete instantiated paths ONLY: the mktemp -d RESULT (e.g. /tmp/tmp.aB3xYz), the log file's parent, the entrypoint dir. TMPDIR itself, /tmp, and other generic ancestors are NEVER owned — a DST under /tmp (e.g. /tmp/hdcs-gate-dst) is ORDINARY and must sync successfully (worked example: mktemp gives /tmp/tmp.aB3xYz; /tmp/hdcs-gate-dst is NOT inside /tmp/tmp.aB3xYz, so no guard fires). Refusing /tmp DSTs = invented scope = the most repeated wall in this project's history. Do not rebuild it.
Refusals cite the SPECIFIC A-number at each refusal site; script headers must NOT enumerate an A-number whitelist (A19 closed the path-law list; later rulings amend the law itself — an enumeration always ends up wrong).
14c. the stage guard must be BIDIRECTIONAL component-overlap on the INSTANTIATED stage path: refuse if stage is inside DST/SRC/owned OR if DST/SRC is inside the stage (a stage that contains DST means cleanup would destroy it — overlap in either direction refuses).
5b. type equivalence is LSTAT-based (A5/A9): [ -d x ] is true for a SYMLINK-TO-DIR — always test [ -L ] separately; a DST symlink-to-dir where SRC has a real dir must be REPLACED (never written through — copies landing outside DST are a breach). Adversarial env combinations beyond this ledger = KNOWN_LIMITATIONS (+open), not FAIL.

=== hdcs-runs-rotation.conf ===
RUNS_DIR=/workspace/hdcs/runs
ARCHIVE_DIR=/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive
AGE_DAYS=14
PATTERN=*.txt
KEEP=50

=== rotate-hdcs-runs.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rotate-hdcs-runs.sh — hdcs runs rotation (dry-run default; --apply to rotate)
# No root required; no logrotate. Conf: hdcs-runs-rotation.conf (same dir as this script).
# Env override precedence: HDCS_RUNS_DIR / HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR > conf > defaults.
# Refusals cite A4 (path law); zero writes on any refusal.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
CONF="$SCRIPT_DIR/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf"

die() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# --- conf parse (KEY=VALUE lines; blanks/# ignored; exactly 5 keys required) ---
declare -A CONFV=()
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  nkeys=0
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in ''|\#*) continue ;; esac
    case "$line" in
      [A-Z_]*=*)
        k="${line%%=*}"; v="${line#*=}"
        CONFV["$k"]="$v"; nkeys=$((nkeys+1)) ;;
      *) die "conf parse: stray line: $line" ;;
    esac
  done < "$CONF"
  [ "$nkeys" -eq 5 ] || die "conf parse: expected exactly 5 KEY=VALUE lines, found $nkeys"
fi

confget() { [ -n "${CONFV[$1]+x}" ] && printf '%s' "${CONFV[$1]}" || printf '%s' "$2"; }

RUNS_DIR="${HDCS_RUNS_DIR-}"
ARCHIVE_DIR="${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR-}"
[ -n "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR+x}" ] && [ -z "$HDCS_RUNS_DIR" ] && die "HDCS_RUNS_DIR is set but empty (refusing)"
[ -n "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR+x}" ] && [ -z "$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR" ] && die "HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR is set but empty (refusing)"
[ -z "$RUNS_DIR" ] && RUNS_DIR="$(confget RUNS_DIR /workspace/hdcs/runs)"
[ -z "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ] && ARCHIVE_DIR="$(confget ARCHIVE_DIR /workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive)"
AGE_DAYS="$(confget AGE_DAYS 14)"
PATTERN="$(confget PATTERN '*.txt')"
KEEP="$(confget KEEP 50)"

case "$AGE_DAYS" in ''|*[!0-9]*) die "AGE_DAYS not a non-negative integer" ;; esac
case "$KEEP" in ''|*[!0-9]*) die "KEEP not a non-negative integer" ;; esac

# --- PATH_LAW (A4): all checks BEFORE any write ---
[ -n "$RUNS_DIR" ] || die "A4: RUNS_DIR degenerate (empty)"
[ -n "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ] || die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR degenerate (empty)"
[ "$RUNS_DIR" != "." ] || die "A4: RUNS_DIR degenerate (.)"
[ "$ARCHIVE_DIR" != "." ] || die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR degenerate (.)"
RUNS_R="$(realpath -m -- "$RUNS_DIR")" || die "A4: realpath RUNS_DIR failed"
ARCH_R="$(realpath -m -- "$ARCHIVE_DIR")" || die "A4: realpath ARCHIVE_DIR failed"
[ "$RUNS_R" != "/" ] || die "A4: RUNS_DIR degenerate (/) after canonicalization"
[ "$ARCH_R" != "/" ] || die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR degenerate (/) after canonicalization"
[ "$RUNS_R" != "$ARCH_R" ] || die "A4: RUNS_DIR == ARCHIVE_DIR ($RUNS_R)"
# containment either direction (component-wise prefix on canonical paths)
case "$ARCH_R/" in "$RUNS_R"/*) die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR inside RUNS_DIR ($ARCH_R under $RUNS_R)" ;; esac
case "$RUNS_R/" in "$ARCH_R"/*) die "A4: RUNS_DIR inside ARCHIVE_DIR ($RUNS_R under $ARCH_R)" ;; esac

APPLY=0
[ "${1-}" = "--apply" ] && APPLY=1

# --- stale scan: STALE := floor(age_days) >= AGE_DAYS; boundary age == AGE_DAYS rotates ---
now=$(date +%s)
cutoff=$((now - AGE_DAYS * 86400))

stale_list=$(mktemp -d /tmp/hdcs-rot-list.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$stale_list"' EXIT
LIST="$stale_list/stale.txt"
: > "$LIST"

while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  m=$(stat -c %Y -- "$f")
  if [ "$m" -le "$cutoff" ]; then
    rel="${f#"$RUNS_R"/}"
    printf '%s\0' "$rel" >> "$LIST"
  fi
done < <(find "$RUNS_R" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -print0)

moved=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' rel; do
  if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ]; then
    src="$RUNS_R/$rel"
    dest_dir="$ARCH_R/$(dirname "$rel")"
    mkdir -p -- "$dest_dir"
    suffix=$(stat -c %Y -- "$src")
    base="$ARCH_R/$rel"
    dest="$base.$suffix"
    n=0
    while [ -e "$dest" ]; do n=$((n+1)); dest="$base.$suffix.$n"; done
    mv -- "$src" "$dest"
    moved=$((moved+1))
  else
    echo "$rel"
  fi
done < "$LIST"

if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  # prune ARCHIVE_DIR to newest KEEP per archived basename (oldest removed first); prune only in apply
  while IFS= read -r -d '' af; do
    rel="${af#"$ARCH_R"/}"
    dir="$(dirname "$rel")"
    name="$(basename "$rel")"
    stem="${name%.*}"
    # group candidates: files matching stem.<epoch>[.n] in this dir
    cands="$stale_list/cands.txt"
    : > "$cands"
    while IFS= read -r -d '' c; do
      cn="$(basename "$c")"
      case "$cn" in
        "$stem".*) printf '%s %s\0' "${cn#"$stem".}" "$c" >> "$cands" ;;
      esac
    done < <(find "$ARCH_R/$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "$stem.*" -print0 2>/dev/null)
    count=$(tr '\0' '\n' < "$cands" | grep -c . || true)
    if [ "$count" -gt "$KEEP" ]; then
      # sort by suffix (numeric-aware, newest first), remove beyond KEEP
      mapfile -d '' -t sorted < <(tr '\0' '\n' < "$cands" | sort -k1,1 -k2,2 -t ' ' -r | tr '\n' '\0')
      i=0
      for entry in "${sorted[@]}"; do
        i=$((i+1))
        [ "$i" -le "$KEEP" ] && continue
        fpath="${entry#* }"
        [ -n "$fpath" ] && [ -f "$fpath" ] && rm -f -- "$fpath"
      done
    fi
  done < <(find "$ARCH_R" -type f -print0)
  echo "apply: moved $moved file(s)"
else
  echo "dry-run: $(tr '\0' '\n' < "$LIST" | grep -c . || echo 0) stale file(s) would rotate (use --apply)"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# verify-rotation.sh — strictly read-only verifier (A6).
# exit 0 iff conf parses, no pending stale rotation, archive listing intact.
# Scratch via mktemp -d OUTSIDE artifact/RUNS/ARCHIVE dirs; stderr via fd redirection.
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
CONF="$SCRIPT_DIR/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf"

RUNS_DIR="${HDCS_RUNS_DIR-/workspace/hdcs/runs}"
ARCHIVE_DIR="${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR-/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive}"
[ -n "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR+x}" ] && [ -z "$HDCS_RUNS_DIR" ] && { echo "HDCS_RUNS_DIR set but empty" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR+x}" ] && [ -z "$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR" ] && { echo "HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR set but empty" >&2; exit 1; }

SCRATCH="$(mktemp -d /tmp/hdcs-verify.XXXXXX)" || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$SCRATCH"' EXIT
exec 2>"$SCRATCH/stderr.log"

FAIL=0

# --- conf parse check (flag accumulator; blanks/# tolerated in general, shipped conf exactly 5) ---
CONF_KEYS=0
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in ''|\#*) continue ;; esac
    case "$line" in
      [A-Z_]*=*) CONF_KEYS=$((CONF_KEYS+1)) ;;
      *) FAIL=1; echo "conf stray line: $line" >&2 ;;
    esac
  done < "$CONF"
else
  FAIL=1; echo "conf missing: $CONF" >&2
fi
if [ "$CONF_KEYS" -ne 5 ]; then
  FAIL=1; echo "conf key count $CONF_KEYS != 5" >&2
fi

# read keys
getconf() {
  local k="$1" line
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in ''|\#*) continue ;; esac
    case "$line" in "$k="*) printf '%s' "${line#*=}"; return ;; esac
  done < "$CONF"
}
AGE_DAYS="$(getconf AGE_DAYS)"; AGE_DAYS="${AGE_DAYS:-14}"
PATTERN="$(getconf PATTERN)"; PATTERN="${PATTERN:-*.txt}"
KEEP="$(getconf KEEP)"; KEEP="${KEEP:-50}"

# --- stale scan (STATUS_PATTERN: flag accumulator, tested AFTER loop) ---
STALE_FOUND=0
if [ -d "$RUNS_DIR" ]; then
  now=$(date +%s)
  cutoff=$((now - AGE_DAYS * 86400))
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    m=$(stat -c %Y -- "$f")
    if [ "$m" -le "$cutoff" ]; then
      STALE_FOUND=1
      echo "pending rotation: ${f#"$RUNS_DIR"/}" >&2
    fi
  done < <(find "$RUNS_DIR" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -print0)
fi
if [ "$STALE_FOUND" -eq 1 ]; then
  FAIL=1
fi

# --- archive listing check (flag accumulator) ---
if [ -d "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ]; then
  LISTING="$ARCHIVE_DIR/listing.txt"
  if [ -f "$LISTING" ]; then
    CMP_FOUND=0
    CMP_OK=0
    while IFS= read -r -d '' af; do
      rel="${af#"$ARCHIVE_DIR"/}"
      [ "$rel" = "listing.txt" ] && continue
      CMP_FOUND=1
      if grep -qF -- "$rel" "$LISTING" 2>/dev/null; then
        expected_ck=$(grep -F -- "$rel" "$LISTING" | awk '{print $1}')
        actual_ck=$(cksum -- "$af" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ "$expected_ck" = "$actual_ck" ]; then
          CMP_OK=$((CMP_OK+1))
        else
          FAIL=1; echo "archive cksum mismatch: $rel" >&2
        fi
      fi
    done < <(find "$ARCHIVE_DIR" -type f ! -name 'listing.txt' -print0)
    if [ "$CMP_FOUND" -eq 1 ] && [ "$CMP_OK" -eq 0 ]; then
      FAIL=1; echo "no archived files matched listing" >&2
    fi
  fi
else
  # archive absent: acceptable only when nothing pending (STALE_FOUND already checked)
  :
fi

if [ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "verify: OK"
  exit 0
fi
echo "verify: FAIL" >&2
exit 1

=== README.md ===
# hdcs runs rotation

Rotates stale files out of `RUNS_DIR` into `ARCHIVE_DIR`, preserving relative
paths, with a timestamped suffix (e.g. `f.txt` -> `f.txt.<epoch>`).

## Files

- `hdcs-runs-rotation.conf` — exactly 5 KEY=VALUE lines:
  `RUNS_DIR=/workspace/hdcs/runs`, `ARCHIVE_DIR=/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive`,
  `AGE_DAYS=14`, `PATTERN=*.txt`, `KEEP=50`.
- `rotate-hdcs-runs.sh` — the rotator.
- `verify-rotation.sh` — strictly read-only verifier (A6).

## Usage

Dry-run is the DEFAULT mode and writes nothing (A1): it only lists the stale
files that would rotate.

```
bash rotate-hdcs-runs.sh          # dry-run: list stale files
bash rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply  # rotate stale files, then prune archive to KEEP
bash verify-rotation.sh           # read-only verification; exit 0 = healthy
```

## Env override precedence

`HDCS_RUNS_DIR` / `HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR` > conf file > built-in defaults.
A set-but-empty env var is refused (exit 1, zero writes).

## Stale boundary semantics

`STALE := floor(age_days) >= AGE_DAYS`. A file whose age equals `AGE_DAYS`
(e.g. exactly 14 days old) IS stale and rotates. The cutoff is computed
explicitly (`mtime <= now - AGE_DAYS*86400` via `stat -c %Y`), never via bare
`-mtime +N`, which would exclude the boundary.

## Apply semantics

- Moves stale files `RUNS_DIR/<rel>` -> `ARCHIVE_DIR/<rel>.<epoch>` (A5_mirror:
  relative path preserved, name preserved, epoch suffix).
- Bytes are lossless (`cmp`-verified).
- Pruning (apply only): keeps the newest `KEEP` archived files per basename,
  removes oldest beyond `KEEP`.
- Idempotence (A5): a second `--apply` is a zero-action no-op; the archive is
  byte-identical afterwards.

## Path law (A4)

Refused (exit != 0, message cites A4, zero writes — all checks precede any
mkdir/mv): `RUNS_DIR == ARCHIVE_DIR`, containment in either direction
(canonicalized via `realpath`), degenerate paths (`''`, `.`, `/` — including
after canonicalization, e.g. `/tmp/../..`).

## Verification (A6)

`verify-rotation.sh` is strictly read-only over the artifact dir, `RUNS_DIR`,
and `ARCHIVE_DIR`. Scratch lives in `mktemp -d` outside all trees; stderr is
redirected via fd. It fails iff the conf does not parse (exactly 5 keys), a
pending stale rotation exists, or the archive listing is not intact. A fresh
`PATTERN` match is normal and does not fail.

## Constraints

- No root required; no logrotate is invoked (MKL1).
- KNOWN_LIMITATIONS (A7, not FAIL): exotic filenames; concurrent writes during
  apply.
